APP Bond Manager Msg Opcodes

group APP_BOND_MANAGER_MSG_Opcodes

Defines

APP_BOND_MGR_SIGN_COUNTER_RESULT_INFO 0x0001

Information for sign counter result. APP shall save data when receiving this opcode. The structure of callback data is T_SIGN_COUNTER_RESULT_INFO.

APP_BOND_MGR_SET_REMOTE_CLIENT_SUPPORTED_FEATURES_INFO 0x0002

Information for setting remote client supported features. APP shall save data when receiving this opcode, and the operation result is the return value of callback T_APP_RESULT. The structure of callback data is T_SET_REMOTE_CLIENT_SUPPORTED_FEATURES_INFO.

APP_BOND_MGR_SET_CCCD_DATA_PENDING_INFO 0x0003

Information for setting CCCD data pending. APP shall save data when receiving this opcode, and the operation result is the return value of callback T_APP_RESULT. The structure of callback data is T_SET_CCCD_DATA_PENDING_INFO.

APP_BOND_MGR_GATT_SERVER_STORE_IND 0x0020

When receiving this opcode with GATT_STORE_OP_GET_CCC_BITS, APP shall call gap_update_cccd_info. When receiving this opcode with GATT_STORE_OP_SET_CCC_BITS, APP shall save data. The structure of callback data is T_GATT_SERVER_STORE_IND.

APP_BOND_MGR_GET_REMOTE_CLIENT_SUPPORTED_FEATURES_IND 0x0040

Indication for getting remote client supported features. APP shall call gap_acl_update_remote_client_supported_features when receiving this opcode. The structure of callback data is T_GET_REMOTE_CLIENT_SUPPORTED_FEATURES_IND.

APP_BOND_MGR_LE_ACL_STATUS_INFO 0x0060

Information for LE ACL status. The structure of callback data is T_LE_ACL_STATUS.

APP_BOND_MGR_LE_AUTHEN_RESULT_IND 0x0080

Indication for LE authentication result. APP shall save data and call le_bond_authen_result_confirm when receiving this opcode. The structure of callback data is T_LE_AUTHEN_RESULT_IND.

APP_BOND_MGR_LE_AUTHEN_KEY_REQ_IND 0x00A0

Indication for LE authentication key request. APP shall call le_bond_authen_key_req_confirm when receiving this opcode. The structure of callback data is T_LE_AUTHEN_KEY_REQ_IND.
